rejected_findings.reason: The capture-derived anclas_3.6.10.10.tsv and Op.cs describe captured lqn as an unidentified one-field message appearing around map changes/reset flows. That contradicts the former Atlas assumption that lqn message id 56 with a quest-id string parameter is the live quest-end signal. Jondo's helper code that emits information messages through Op.Lqn is insufficient to override the real-capture contradiction.
